'''12-4C-41 traffic control droids''' were a series of traffic controller [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. These droids were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in stature, with many similarities to the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].

==Description==
12-4C-41 traffic control [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were designed to resemble a bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]]. This configuration was chosen as over ninety percent of [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] control towers were designed to accommodate organic workers, and having standard Humanoid frames allowed them to interface with the equipment with ease.<ref name="EGTD" /> Physically, the droids resembled [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]].<ref name="FF28" />

The 12-4C-41 was equipped with an advanced [[optic/recorder system]] that allowed the droid to switch between both panoramic and macroscopic views. The unit was fully capable of taking in data from dozens of [[Viewscreen/Legends|monitor screens]] while also visually tracking wayward [[Starship/Legends|starships]] through [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of dense fog. All of this information was fed into the droid's multilayered [[Droid brain/Legends|cognitive processor]]<ref name="EGTD" /> which contained an extensive database of vehicle and vessel classes, including identifying marks and landing codes.<ref name="FF28" /> A [[data probe]] in a 12-4C-41's left index finger allowed the droid to access specialist databases<ref name="EGTD" /> and to update its own internal databases. The probe was capable of interfacing directly with standard [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals and<ref name="FF28" /> allowed the droid to access information on a number of subjects including vehicle classes, landing codes, and transit protocols.<ref name="EGTD" />

The torso of a 12-4C-41 droid doubled as a [[Portable beacon|landing beacon]]. An omnidirectional [[Floodlight/Legends|floodlight]] was installed, covered by smoky translucent<ref name="EGTD" /> [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]<ref name="FF28" /> panels. Designed to be used in an emergency, such as a spaceport or landing field losing power<ref name="EGTD" /> or bad weather conditions,<ref name="FF28" /> the floodlight could be programmed to flash in a number of patterns and in a variety of [[Color/Legends|colors]]. The droids were also equipped with [[zero-gee maneuvering jet]]s mounted on their thighs which allowed them to move around in a [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. On some orbital stations, the [[Administrator/Legends|administrators]] would employ a number of 12-4C-41s to use their floodlights to guide vessels into a berth. A variant version of the 12-4C-41, designated as the [[12-4C-41/b]], was produced specifically for that role. It was substantially cheaper but at the cost of having a cognitive module with limited capabilities.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
[[Controller droid/Legends|Traffic controller droids]] were developed as a viable alternative to using organics or [[Computer/Legends|computers]] in the role. Due to the stressful but tedious nature of the job, organics often because exhausted and fatigued, while automated computer landing systems<ref name="EGTD" /> proved to be less efficient<ref name="FF28" /> and produced a number of fatal collisions<ref name="EGTD" /> due to their inability to make informed decisions during unexpected events. The droids were also developed in an effort to regulate traffic and to combat concerns that authorities had around crime and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]].<ref name="FF28" />

[[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] 12-4C-21 traffic control droid had an exemplary service record and reputation.<ref name="FF28" /> [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] utilized 12-4C-41 traffic controller droids, including [[12-4C-41|Wuntoo Forcee Forwun]]. When the rogue [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] destroyed a quarter of the [[City/Legends|city's]] droid population and then fled, Wuntoo left his post to track EV-9D9 down, following her to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he enacted his revenge on the sadistic droid.<ref name="EGTD" />
